name: Utuh watcher
description: Holds the watcher role on Creditcoin's Attestcoin Protocol: sweeps bonded completeness claims on CC3 Testnet against Ethereum and refutes one that omits an event, taking half its bond. Exposed as an MCP server (npm utuh-mcp; official MCP Registry io.github.PugarHuda/utuh-mcp). Four read-only tools, one transaction tool that requires confirm: true. Testnet only.
